name: ERC-LSHADE (Eigenvector-Rotated)
tagline: L-SHADE current-to-pbest with bounce-back boundaries plus a condition-number-driven probability of doing the binomial crossover in eigenvector space.
init_recovers: L-SHADE baseline when condition number is low (p_rot=0)
diff_from_baseline: Augments lshade baseline with: PCA eigenvector basis recomputed every 25 generations; binomial crossover applied in eigenbasis with probability scaling with log10(cond); bounce-back boundary handling; explicit stagnation-driven random restart of worst 20%.

name: Multi-Strategy L-SHADE
tagline: L-SHADE with three mutation operators (rand/1, current-to-pbest/1, best/1) sampled uniformly per individual, plus a 100-gen-stagnation restart trigger.
init_recovers: lshade baseline when only the pbest strategy is active
diff_from_baseline: Compared to lshade, adds two extra mutation strategies (rand/1 and best/1) chosen uniformly per individual, sets N_min = max(4, dim), and triggers a stagnation-based restart after 100 generations without improvement.

name: CMA-ES + LSHADE Co-Evolution
tagline: Splits the population: a (mu, lambda) CMA-ES samples lambda offspring while an LSHADE current-to-pbest population evolves the rest; the two pools share the running best each generation.
formula:
$$\lambda_{\text{cma}} = \max(4,\,4 + 3\lfloor\ln d\rfloor),\quad N_{\text{de}} = N - \lambda_{\text{cma}}$$
$$\text{CMA: } x \sim \mathcal{N}(m, \sigma^{2}C),\ \sigma_0 = (h-l)/4$$
$$\text{DE: } v_i = x_i + F(x_{\text{pbest}}-x_i) + F(x_{r1}-x_{r2\cup A}),\ \text{binomial CR}$$

nodes.label: CMA update + DE greedy + Lehmer M_F/M_CR

init_recovers: Pure LSHADE if lambda_cma=0; pure CMA-ES if N_de=0
diff_from_baseline: Combines a CMA-ES strategy (deap.cma) with an LSHADE current-to-pbest population in the same generation: both produce trials, the global best is injected back into CMA's update, and CMA's best replaces DE's worst. Distinct from any single baseline.

name: Competitive DE/EDA + Coordinate Search
tagline: Each individual races a current-to-pbest DE trial against a rank-mu EDA donor (mean+path+sigma); winner runs greedy selection; quasi-opposition init and adaptive coordinate pattern search around incumbent.

key_hyperparams.name: select
key_hyperparams.value: rank-biased tournament k=3 with 20% elite pick

diff_from_baseline: Hybridizes L-SHADE with a CMA-style rank-mu EDA: per individual, a DE current-to-pbest donor and an EDA donor (mean + evolution path + diagonal sigma) compete, winner faces greedy selection; on top, quasi-opposition init, coordinate pattern search around best_ever, and a competitive eda_bias tuned by win ratio.
